name: Walsh University
academic_ranking: Private Catholic university founded in 1960 by the Brothers of Christian Instruction. Located in North Canton, OH. Enrollment ~2,192 (fall 2024): ~1,523 undergraduates and ~669 postgraduates. Offers 70+ undergraduate majors and graduate programs including DPT, MSN, MBA, and DNP.
financial_aid: Walsh University markets itself as an affordable Catholic institution with merit- and need-based aid available. Specific percent-of-students-aided figures were not published on pages checked 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Softball competes as an NCAA D2 program in the G-MAC. The athletics facilities page (athletics.walsh.edu/facilities) listed no facility details ('There are no facilities to show') as of 2026-07; no dedicated softball field/stadium name was publicly listed.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II softball program competing in the Great Midwest Athletic Conference (G-MAC) as the Walsh Cavaliers. Team X/social account: @WalshUSoftball.
notes: Data sourced from athletics.walsh.edu softball coaches and roster pages (fetched 2026-07). The public site walshcavaliers.com was unreachable; athletics.walsh.edu is the working mirror/canonical Sidearm site. Tuition & fees ($33,030, AY 2024-2025) confirmed via Univstats (IPEDS/NCES-based). Roster count of 24 taken from the 2027 softball roster page.
